dct_description_sm: The data is already published by Poultry Science Journal

The study addressed the nutritional limitation of conventional soybean meal by evaluating whether targeted post-processing strategies could improve protein accessibility and digestion efficiency. By linking changes in secondary protein structure with in vitro digestion kinetics and broiler performance responses, the work aimed to identify processing approaches that enhance soybean meal nutritive value and support more efficient protein utilization in broiler production.
dct_title_s: Further processing of soybean meal using thermomechanical and enzyme-facilitation modified secondary protein structure, in-vitro protein digestion kinetics and nutritive value in broiler chickens
